title: Agentic Incident Response Playbook: What Should Happen When an Agent Takes an Unrecoverable Action?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: survey existing systems, synthesize a playbook, then test whether agents respond to it. The causal link from playbook-as-system-prompt to safer behavior is speculative, but the survey itself fills a real gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Mostly qualitative research (surveying documentation) plus straightforward prompt engineering experiments. No heavy compute needed. Beginners can handle documentation surveys and simple prompting experiments.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Surveying 20-30 systems' documentation is achievable but time-consuming. The playbook synthesis is doable, but adding 10 crisis scenario tests stretches the 30hr budget. Would benefit from scoping down to fewer systems.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
